key.name: style
key.summary: How a new wallpaper or theme is revealed
key.description: grow opens a circle from the pointer, outer closes in on it from the edges, wipe sweeps a soft edge across at an angle, wave sweeps a wavy one, fade crossfades, random picks one of the first four at a random angle, and none leaves the change to GNOME.

key.name: duration
key.summary: How long the transition takes, in milliseconds

key.name: reveal
key.description: As a session starts, the boot splash's gem flies into the top bar while the desktop appears. Skipped with animations off.
